common.missingSignedInUser: Missing signed-in user. Please sign in again.
common.missingSupabaseConfig: Missing Supabase config. Check the environment variables.

home.title: Turn inventory records into a clear management workspace
home.description: The public home page explains the product at a glance. After signing in, users enter the dashboard to manage inventory data, categories, locations, and item lists.

googleSheets.title: Flexible sign-in options
googleSheets.description: Support email-password sign-in and Google sign-in so users can access the system with a familiar account.

database.title: Supabase database
database.description: Use Supabase PostgreSQL for inventory items, stock movements, user data, and Supabase Auth for sign-in.

stack.title: Modern frontend stack
stack.description: Built with Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Pinia, Nuxt UI, and i18n for a maintainable admin interface.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The signed-in workspace summarizes inventory status and recent management activity.

lowStock.title: Low stock alerts
lowStock.description: Items whose quantity is at or below their custom threshold.

categoryChart.title: Items by main category
categoryChart.description: A simple distribution chart for current inventory items.

recentMovements.title: Recent movements
recentMovements.description: Latest inventory changes recorded by the system.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This page shows basic information for the signed-in account. Name, role, and permissions can be added later.

quickUse.title: Quick use
quickUse.description: Enter a barcode or upload a barcode image. Existing items open the edit page, and unknown barcodes open the create item page.
quickUse.routeHint: After the barcode is recognized, the system will route you to the right workflow automatically.
quickUse.unsupported: Barcode image detection is not supported by this browser. You can still enter the barcode manually.
quickUse.unsupportedImageType: This image format is not supported. Please use JPG, PNG, or WebP.
quickUse.noBarcodeFound: No barcode was detected in this image.
quickUse.existingItemDescription: This barcode matches an inventory item. Adjust the quantity below.
quickUse.newItemDescription: No item uses this barcode yet. Create a new inventory item with this barcode.

data.title: Data
data.description: Start by creating the categories, locations, groups, and items needed for inventory management.

sections.categoryDescription: Main categories define the broad item type. Subcategories belong under a main category.
sections.metaDescription: Locations track where items are stored. Groups can organize items by brand or series.
sections.itemDescription: Create inventory items and connect them to a subcategory, group, and location.
sections.listDescription: Inventory records currently stored in Supabase.
sections.currentDataDescription: Review the categories, locations, and groups already stored in Supabase.

pages.createItemDescription: Open a dedicated form for adding inventory records.
pages.editItemDescription: Update the item name, quantity, category, group, location, and notes.
pages.itemListDescription: Review the inventory records currently stored in Supabase.

form.groupPlaceholder: For example: Brand A cat treats
form.notePlaceholder: Expiration date, spec, or other details

dialog.confirmDelete: Delete this data? This action cannot be undone.
dialog.inUse: This data is currently in use and cannot be deleted.

auth.emailAlreadyExists: This email is already registered. Please sign in instead.

logs.title: Inventory logs
logs.description: Review item creation, edits, deletes, and quantity changes.
